sections.title: Section 128 - Collection of Tax from Lease of Property The officer responsible for registration under the Registration Act, 1908 (Act No. XVI of 1908)
sections.content_text: Section 128 - Collection of Tax from Lease of Property The officer responsible for registration under the Registration Act, 1908 (Act No. XVI of 1908) shall not register any document relating to the lease of any immovable property for a term of less than 10 (ten) years, unless tax is paid at the rate of 4% (four percent) on the lease value of such property.
